issues.quote: Per-rooftop settings: owner source (Spyne assignee, takeover claimant, later CRM salesperson or DMS advisor), missed calls [E31], alert recipients [E33].
issues.concern: My reps get paid on the salesperson VinSolutions says owns the up. This ships a Spyne round-robin pick, or whoever clicked takeover, as 'mine' and pushes the real CRM salesperson to 'later'. Rep A gets told to answer rep B's customer, answers it, and now I have a commission fight on the floor. Takeover claimant as owner is worse: a manager or another rep who jumps in to save a lead becomes the owner. You already wrote that a wrong owner is worse than team Unread; the recommendation still makes the wrong owner the default.
issues.because: crm-core-service:src/assignment/assignment.service.ts:90 (assignee is a Spyne round-robin pick, cited in the one-pager's own risk); E6, E13 (reps work VinSolutions); missing (no evidence the round-robin assignee matches the CRM salesperson, Q17, Q18)
issues.ask: For sales, make the CRM assigned salesperson the only 'mine' source where the CRM exposes it (VinSolutions first, this rooftop). Use the Spyne assignee only at rooftops where Spyne's round-robin IS the store's assignment of record, confirmed per rooftop. Drop takeover claimant as an owner source; takeover is an action, not ownership. Where neither holds, ship the team Unanswered view, not a guessed 'mine'.

issues.quote: - **Owner filter** on the team list from the lead assignee `conversational-ai-backend:src/leads/schemas/lead.schema.ts:42`; Vini action items inherit that owner, not SYSTEM.
issues.concern: Re-pointing Vini action items from SYSTEM to the round-robin owner is fine inside the console, but action items sync to the CRM. If that sync carries the assignee, you are now writing a rep onto a task in VinSolutions that may not be that customer's salesperson. That is rep assignment getting overwritten in my system of record, which breaks my pipeline report and who gets paid.
issues.because: E38 (action-item queue has an isSynced filter, so items sync out); conversational-ai-backend:src/crm_integration/crm_integration.service.ts:693 (cited in the one-pager); missing (whether the CRM sync writes an assignee)
issues.ask: State that the owner change is console-only and never written to the CRM task or lead owner, or show that the sync does not carry an assignee. Inherit the owner only from the CRM salesperson (see the owner-source issue), not the round-robin pick.

issues.quote: - **Unanswered state:** stamp last customer message and last human reply on the inbound path, cleared by a reply, not a view `conversational-ai-backend:src/sms/sms.service.ts:1924`. `isUnread` stays as is; it drives service metrics and the Customers count `conversational-ai-backend:src/service-metrics/contact-metrics.service.ts:1743`.
issues.concern: 'Last customer message' with no 'last human reply' means every customer text Vini already handled lands in my reps' unanswered queue. On about 600 leads a month that is a list nobody can clear, and the first week my guys see 80 items they stop opening it. Unanswered has to mean the customer is waiting on a person: asked for a human, asked something Vini cannot answer (price, payment, trade), or Vini handed off. Not 'a human has not typed since the customer did'.
issues.because: E10 (600 leads a month, dealer-stated); E31 (dealer wants 'unanswered phone call or unanswered message', i.e. waiting on someone); missing (no count of how many customer messages Vini resolves alone)
issues.ask: Define the entry rule as 'customer is waiting on a human' (handoff, needs-human flag, question Vini is not allowed to answer, missed call), not every customer message without a human reply. Size the queue per rep per day at this rooftop before building (see requests).

issues.quote: - **Unanswered state:** stamp last customer message and last human reply on the inbound path, cleared by a reply, not a view `conversational-ai-backend:src/sms/sms.service.ts:1924`. `isUnread` stays as is; it drives service metrics and the Customers count `conversational-ai-backend:src/service-metrics/contact-metrics.service.ts:1743`.
issues.concern: 'Cleared by a reply' only counts replies sent from the console. My salespeople answer from VinSolutions texting, from a phone call, or face to face when the customer walks in. None of that clears this flag, so the queue fills with customers who were already handled and the rep learns to ignore it. Same failure as Unread, just slower.
issues.because: E13 (two VinSolutions tabs open, CRM is where the floor works); E16 ('two CRMs'); missing (no read of CRM activity or outbound calls named as a clear signal)
issues.ask: List what clears the state: console SMS reply, outbound call from Spyne, and CRM activity (text, call, logged contact) if we can read it. Name the CRM activity read as a dependency with whether we have it for VinSolutions, and add a one-click 'handled elsewhere' clear for the rest.

issues.quote: A rep or advisor cannot open Conversations and see the replies waiting on them. We add a true "unanswered" state, an owner per conversation and a live count, for both departments. It removes cross-checking Action Items and the CRM and makes reply wait time measurable.

issues.ask: Change the TL;DR to what it actually removes: the Action Items cross-check and the hunt for which replies are yours. Say plainly that the CRM is still where the record is closed.

issues.concern: Alerts to the owner only. On a Saturday my rep is with a customer or off, and the alert sits on his phone while the lead goes cold. There is no escalation, and no word on which channel these preferences deliver on. If it is a console notification or email, the floor never sees it.
